verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same broken structure. The three equal price cards end up at three different sizes and heights (Monthly smallest and lowest, Family largest), which breaks the side-by-side comparison and makes Family stand out over the highlighted Yearly plan. The subhead is a cramped centred block jammed above Monthly, and the legal text is unreadably small under the CTA. A is marginally better because it leaves slightly more room at the edges. B pushes the Monthly card (about 26px) and the CTA closer to the canvas edges and is otherwise nearly identical.
